description: §66.12.6 rules 1 and 3: `b.xs.pop()` on the tape FIELD of a struct local is a shrink at the end, judged by the field's own type `int[free, append]`, which grants no `pop` (nor `remove`) — E-WRITE-NOT-GRANTED. Holding the tape inside a local struct does not lift its grants.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — NO unconstrained sequence behaviour anywhere in the language" ("No position escapes the grant check. That covers locals, parameters, returns, struct fields, tuple positions …")
rationale: §66.12.6 rule 3: "Each method is a write: it is checked against the target's grants exactly as a whole-value write is … An ungranted one is E-WRITE-NOT-GRANTED"; rule 1: "a struct field whose type is a tape (§66.11.4: the field's tape type carries its grants)".
